name: Form Clarification
implementation_notes: Clarification Detail grid renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from clarificationRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Boiler Room Detail (screen-078's mobile precedent)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23), mirroring FormBoilerRoomView.vue's availableTimeSlotOptions() exactly

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 kolom terisi) validated at FE + repo level (clarificationRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws ClarificationDetailRequiredError) -- this station has only 7 non-time_slot columns, all of which participate in the 'filled' check

All 6 numeric columns (Clarification Tank Temp, Oil Tank Temperature, Sludge Tank Temp, Buffer Tank Level, Pure Oil Production Rate, Downtime) are plain type=number FormFields; Findings is a plain text FormField -- NO enum/status dropdowns anywhere on this screen, the simplest field set of any station in the project
UNLIKE Form Threshing/Form Boiler Room: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no CollapsibleSection, no static-constant data file, per this station's explicit scope

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. clarification-tank-temp-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- same defensive pattern as FormBoilerRoomView.vue

Field order in the grid & template mirrors the migration column order exactly: Clarification Tank Temp -> Oil Tank Temperature -> Sludge Tank Temp -> Buffer Tank Level -> Pure Oil Production Rate -> Downtime -> Findings = 7 total

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): FormClarificationView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('clarification_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/clarification-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif, dan penolakannya (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) DIAM — record tetap 'saved' dan alasannya baru tampil di SyncResultDialog pada sinkron manual screen-006. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('clarification', mill, date) di ClarificationRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Tidak ada test mobile khusus periode untuk layar ini (form tidak punya logika periode untuk diuji). Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), dan mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik). Kegagalan write-through yang diam dicakup secara generik oleh mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task -- component test coverage (FormClarificationView.spec.ts, 20 tests) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's full Simpan/Pause/Clear/Back flow in a live dev server.
